thread:
incident-bot: 🟠 Pager: PROD SRE oncall paged — multiple container restarts on serving-runtime (gpu nodes) during prefill. Suspected: GPU OOMs. Runbook: <https://runbooks.internal/prefill-oom>
mike: ack — I'm oncall, looking now. which customers impacted?
sara: seeing spike in pod restarts across hotpool-us-west-2, ~12 containers in last 6m. some 502s reported by gateway.
jia: adding context from runtime metrics — KV cache allocations spike when large context requests hit. token hist shows a handful of requests with very large prefill lengths (~120k tokens).
carla: support: two enterprise customers reported increased 5xx, one posted on support channel about streaming cutouts. escalating to CSM.
mike: grabbing logs from one crashing pod
mike: ```
# kubectl logs serving-xyz-7f9 -c runtime --since=5m
2026-03-17T02:12:03Z ERROR runtime: CUDA error: out of memory
2026-03-17T02:12:03Z runtime: RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 1.15 GiB (GPU 0; 31.75 GiB total capacity; 29.55 GiB already allocated)
2026-03-17T02:12:04Z kernel: container runtime: process killed with OOM
2026-03-17T02:12:04Z kubelet: Pod "serving-xyz-7f9" container "runtime" terminated with exit code 137
```
deploy-bot: deploy status: no recent infra deploys to serving-runtime in last 24h. CI: green.
mike: initial mitigation — disabling large-context routing for a minute to stop inflight large-prefill requests. hitting internal API now.
sara: command? mike: ```
# curl -X POST "https://console.internal/api/v1/routing/policies" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ****" \
  -d '{"policy":"block_prefill_over_token_count","threshold":8192,"action":"reject"}'
```
jia: good — also enabling aggressive KV eviction and reducing per-request KV reserve on the pods (hotpatch). pushing config change to runtime configmap.
mike: ```
# kubectl set env deployment/serving-runtime PREFILL_KV_RESERVE=0.02
# kubectl rollout restart deployment/serving-runtime
``` 
mike: rolling restart started for hotpool subset only to avoid large churn — will monitor OOMs and restart rate.
carla: customer comms draft: "We're investigating increased 5xx responses; temporary routing throttle applied to extremely large requests. No data loss; working on hotfix to reduce memory usage. Will update in 30m." ok to send?
tom: +1 from CSM, please include ETA and ask any impacted customers to DM us logs.
jia: quick analysis — looks like a client-side concat bug generated repeated history causing huge prefill. We should add a hard prefill token ceiling at the edge as defense-in-depth.
sara: i'm going to cordon node gpu-07 (highest restart count) to stop further noisy restarts while hotpatch propagates.
mike: ```
# kubectl cordon gpu-07
# kubectl drain gpu-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
``` 
sara: cordon/drain in progress. moving remaining traffic off that node.
deploy-bot: autoscaler: scaled up fallback pool (cpu-only) + routing now directs non-low-latency tiers to fallback models.
mike: observed restart rate dropping after routing change and env tweak. current OOMs: 1 in last 10m vs 8 in previous 6m.
jia: plan: 1) push KV-trim hotpatch (done), 2) add edge prefill hard limit (followup PR), 3) postmortem + client contact. I'll own the PR.
carla: customer update sent to affected accounts. they want a post-incident note.
tom: noted — collecting impacted customer list and SLA hits.
sara: handing off overnight watch to jia. mike and i will summarize actions and runbook deviations.
mike: short summary for handoff: cause suspected client concat bug => extremely large prefill requests => KV cache balloon => GPU OOM => container restarts. Mitigations: routing throttle for prefill > 8192 tokens, set PREFILL_KV_RESERVE=0.02, cordoned noisy node, enabled KV eviction, scaled fallback pool, customer comms sent. Monitoring: OOM rate down, restart churn reduced. next: edge hard limit PR (jia), postmortem schedule.
jia: ack taking over. will monitor for 2h and follow up with PR link.
incident-bot: INC-2026-3500 created and linked to channel. severity: SEV2. paging/escalation rules applied.
carla: thanks all — will coordinate postmortem template and customer summary later.
mike: +1 thanks, good teamwork :thumbsup:
